name: ringg-router-e2b
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from google/gemma-4-E2B-it (config.json max_position_embeddings 131072). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from google/gemma-4-E2B-it: 7 full GQA layers (kv heads 1, head_dim 256) and 28 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-26. A finetune of google/gemma-4-E2B-it, not a new base model: same config.json, same 5.104 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-09-29. CAVEATS: Task is one-forward-pass JSON routing over a fixed option list (task=decision, excluded from the worth-running ranking and scored on the Decision Index). Trained on 15 public task suites, so most of the held-out rows are in-distribution by construction; the card's own 'unseen task suites, never trained' row is the honest one and there it LOSES to Gemma-4-E4B-it (71.2 vs 76.6, base E2B 64.8). Same-prompt, bf16, greedy, vLLM for all three models.
